status: Selected complete-FFT candidates are recovered from 51e346c (branch) and 5e37821 (uniform); optional historical_e4aa1b0 and historical_652808b measure explicitly partial instruction paths in timing-only mode. The branch previously passed local A100 R1 checks; selected uniform R1 validation remains pending. Exact paper identity is unconfirmed and original radix16/stage-wise radix4 sources remain missing. The top-level source_files/extracted_functions describe the retained inactive 403c6ae header.

source_files.role: Reference radix-8 shared-stage layout for reconstruction, not copied as a radix-16 or radix-4 original

adaptations: Extracted the minimal TF32 device/helper/global closure into one self-contained CUDA header; omitted the legacy host benchmark headers and unrelated FP16/prototype functions.
Wrapped recovered names in namespace thff_table7_legacy. Replaced needed preprocessor constants by same-value namespace constexpr constants to avoid leaking macros.
Kept W arithmetic and the original double PI literal; changed the PI identifier to local kLegacyPi to avoid collisions with existing project PI macros.
Added __syncwarp() after the branch global shared-output store loop, before cross-lane shared reads for the final global stores.

Fixed the historical uniform global output omission: retained the i<ept loop and original first-group index, and added a same-column store into batch laneid/4+8 from reg[i+ept] for both real and imaginary lanes. Input/output mappings and core arithmetic are otherwise preserved.
Removed trailing whitespace while preserving executable statements and original loop-unroll directives.
known_limitations: Exact paper-stage identity remains unconfirmed; no recovered original is available for the first two rows.
N=64, forward, FP32 storage with historical TF32 raw-bit MMA input behavior, one warp per block, batch a positive multiple of 16. No batch-tail support.
R>1 reuses the resident layout without another input digit reversal; it is a throughput workload, while the optional complete-FFT accuracy gate uses R=1.
The former reconstructed first two kernels are retained for diagnostics under reconstructed_* IDs and are not eligible to fill the original paper rows.
Both selected implementations use LUTs but differ in fragment layouts, permutation and unrolling; their comparison does not isolate one optimization.
The uniform source is now the original 5e37821 with complete output stores. It has not undergone the artifact R1 gate; previous validation of repaired 403c6ae is not transferred.

The optional partial kernels omit MMA B-fragment initialization; 652808b also omits inter-stage permutation. Their compiler-dependent emitted instruction timings measure declared partial functions, not complete FFT correctness.

adaptations: New mixed-radix digit mapping, dense real matrix embedding and stage driver.
All A fragments are loaded before shared output is overwritten; warp barriers publish stages.
Shared layout uses 16 transforms and stride 64+9 from the historical shared-stage convention.

reconstructed_kernels.name: thff_table7_legacy::fft_kernel_radix4_shared_batch16
adaptations: Adapted the historical radix-8 shared-stage layout to radix-4 with one m16n8k8 instruction per butterfly.
Added a warp barrier before each butterfly's in-place stores; retained barriers between stages.
Every stage loads and stores shared memory rather than retaining FFT data across stages in registers.
